capabilities.title: Mission 1 result continuation to Mission 2 (injected outcome)
capabilities.limits: The browser check removes enemy units and advances a tick to trigger victory before clicking Continue. It proves result continuation, not natural Mission 1 victory or original timing.

capabilities.title: Mission 2 fresh-page checkpoint restoration
capabilities.limits: The diagnostic also uses direct commands/ticks and injected state. Browser IndexedDB continuation is a modernization. It does not establish original save-format or whole-world parity.

capabilities.title: Mission 3 opening, first construction and Preacher
capabilities.limits: The check seeds Mission 2 victory, then exercises shipped continuation. Later Mission 3 behavior and full original comparison remain unknown.

capabilities.title: Mission 2 ordinary public checkpoint restoration
capabilities.limits: Public save, fresh page and Load with real RAF and read-only observations. An additional evidence method for the existing checkpoint capability, not extra progress credit. Browser checkpoint modernization does not establish original save-format compatibility or native-game parity.

capabilities.title: Blast ordinary person cast and impact
capabilities.limits: Owned public Mission 2 person release, real windup move and friendly Blue Brave tracking through arrival/impact. Historical browser observations only when source differs; no enemy-target, native execution, paired-frame, hardware-performance or whole-spell claim.

capabilities.title: Blast ordinary controls and active checkpoint
capabilities.limits: Six public Mission 2 control stages including active-cast Save and fresh-page Load. Equality covers the bounded saved/loaded projection; the recorded digest is not an independent full-World recomputation. No original execution, save-format or paired parity claim.

checks.reason: Rejected historical Blast reference evidence: missing/ambiguous shard manifest
coveredBehavior: Six compared arrival/head-retirement and first enemy/friendly impulse snapshots
limits: Historical-reference provenance; raw native execution attestation is missing and original execution remains unknown, including on a matching port source tree.

Supplied gameFlags32 and a ground cast do not validate the ordinary bit-clear person-selection path. Native allocation, deletion and person bodies are supplied; the full fixture event log is not port-compared.
Unscored check detail only. No complete Blast, native whole-game, native timing, matched-frame or hardware-performance credit.

limits: Owned public Mission 2 person release, real windup move and friendly Blue Brave tracking through arrival/impact. Historical browser observations only when source differs; no enemy-target, native execution, paired-frame, hardware-performance or whole-spell claim.

coveredBehavior: Public Save checkpoint, fresh reload, public Load, retained turn/roster/stats and real-clock resumption
limits: Only the exact reviewed ordinary scenario and source-bound owned harness are accepted. This is browser checkpoint modernization, not original save compatibility or full mission parity. Historical source changes produce stale evidence.

coveredBehavior: First visit offers Missions 1 through 4 before scene creation
Mission 1 mouse and Mission 4 keyboard selection

coveredBehavior: Mission 2 result continuation into Mission 3 data and objectives
Mission 3 original opening flyby and one-shot Convert Wild cast

limits: Seeds Mission 2 victory before exercising the real continuation path; it does not prove natural Mission 2 or Mission 3 victory.
Later Mission 3 recurring raids, warnings, marker behavior, and broader tutorial presentation remain deferred.

historical.label: Historical manually assessed checkpoint-share coverage; not current automatic measurement

limits: Unknown is unmeasured, not evidence that the game has zero implemented behavior.
